metadata.question: Does the cloud cover increase in the Rocky Mountain region (specifically centered at coordinates 50.332360, -116.939238, with a radius of 60 km) on December 5th, 2020, compared to December 2nd, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about cloud cover increase in the Rocky Mountain region between two specific dates (Dec 2 vs Dec 5, 2020). I need to: 1. Define the geometry - a circle with 60km radius around coordinates (50.332360, -116.939238) 2. Use MODIS or Sentinel data to get cloud cover information 3. Compare cloud cover between the two dates 4. Handle potential missing data issues For cloud cover analysis, MODIS MOD09GA or MOD09GQ would be good options as they have reliable cloud detection. I'll use MOD09GA which has daily surface reflectance with cloud flags. Strategy: - Use MOD09GA collection - Extract cloud state from 'state_1km' band using bitmask - Calculate cloud percentage for each date - Compare the two percentages Potential issues: - No data for either date (C1) - Heavy cloud cover leaving no valid pixels (C2) - Invalid calculations (C3) I'll use a 1000m scale for reduceRegion to avoid timeout. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.939238, 50.332360]); const region = center.buffer(60000); // 60km radius const date1 = '2020-12-02'; const date2 = '2020-12-05'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS for cloud detection const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD09GA') .filterBounds(region); // Get images for both dates const img1 = modisCol.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).first(); const img2 = modisCol.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).first(); // Check if images exist const img1Exists = img1 ? true : false; const img2Exists = img2 ? true : false; if (!img1Exists || !img2Exists) { console.log(`Dec 2 image exists: ${img1Exists}`); console.log(`Dec 5 image exists: ${img2Exists}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Function to calculate cloud percentage from MODIS state band function getCloudPercentage(img) { // Extract cloud state from state_1km band (bits 0-1: 00=clear, 01=cloudy, 10=mixed, 11=not set) const cloudState = img.select('state_1km').bitwiseAnd(3); const cloudyPixels = cloudState.eq(1); // Cloudy state const clearPixels = cloudState.eq(0); // Clear state const totalCount = cloudyPixels.add(clearPixels).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('state_1km'); const cloudCount = cloudyPixels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('state_1km'); return [cloudCount, totalCount]; } // Calculate cloud percentages const [cloudCount1, totalCount1] = getCloudPercentage(img1); const [cloudCount2, totalCount2] = getCloudPercentage(img2); const cloudPct1 = (cloudCount1.getInfo() / totalCount1.getInfo()) * 100; const cloudPct2 = (cloudCount2.getInfo() / totalCount2.getInfo()) * 100; // Check for valid pixels if (totalCount1.getInfo() === 0 || totalCount2.getInfo() === 0) { console.log(`Dec 2 valid pixels: ${totalCount1.getInfo()}`); console.log(`Dec 5 valid pixels: ${totalCount2.getInfo()}`); console.log("C2"); return; } // Validate calculations if (isNaN(cloudPct1) || isNaN(cloudPct2) || cloudPct1 < 0 || cloudPct1 > 100 || cloudPct2 < 0 || cloudPct2 > 100) { console.log(`Dec 2 cloud %: ${cloudPct1}`); console.log(`Dec 5 cloud %: ${cloudPct2}`); console.log("C3"); return; } // Print results and determine answer console.log(`Dec 2 cloud cover: ${cloudPct1.toFixed(1)}%`); console.log(`Dec 5 cloud cover: ${cloudPct2.toFixed(1)}%`); console.log(`Cloud change: ${(cloudPct2 - cloudPct1).toFixed(1)}%`); if (cloudPct2 > cloudPct1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
